summary: Tested Trial Period Management, Minor Athlete Login, and Standard Logins. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: Login page shows two tabs (Accesso Standard/Accesso Atleta), Minor login with code/PIN works correctly, Minor dashboard displays all required info (trial banner, QR code, schedule, stats). Standard login button has known intermittent click issue but works via keyboard Enter.

ui_bugs.issue: Accedi button sometimes unresponsive to Playwright click (works with keyboard Enter). Known issue from previous iteration. Button is visible but React Native Web TouchableOpacity may not respond to synthetic clicks.

trial_status_api.description: Returns is_trial, waiting_first_attendance, trial_active, trial_start_date, trial_end_date, days_remaining, trial_expired

start_trial_api.description: Activates trial mode, sets is_trial=true, clears trial dates for auto-start on first attendance

trial_document_api.description: Returns PDF with Content-Type: application/pdf, valid %PDF header, ~15KB file

trial_bypass_certificate_check.description: check_athlete_status at line ~1207 returns allowed=True for trial athletes without certificate. Logic checks trial_active and returns warning about certificate needed at trial end.

minor_login_api.description: Works with code=KWP9R9PJWJXJ pin=1234. Returns token with role='minor'

minor_dashboard_api.description: Returns athlete data, team, schedule (training_sessions, match_day), stats (total/weekly/monthly attendances), trial_info, recent_attendances

login_page_two_tabs.description: Login page shows 'Accesso Standard' and 'Accesso Atleta' tabs

minor_login_ui_flow.description: Clicking 'Accesso Atleta' tab shows code/PIN form. Login redirects to /minor dashboard.

minor_dashboard_ui.description: Shows: Ciao LUCIA, Pallavolo Perugia SSD, Periodo di Prova banner, QR Code section with code KWP9R9PJWJXJ, Team Under 14, Presenze Totali, Questo Mese, Orario Allenamenti (Lunedi/Mercoledi/Venerdi + Partita)

parent_athlete_trial_section.description: parent/athlete/[id].tsx contains 'Periodo di Prova' section (lines 2124-2225) with waiting/active/expired states and download PDF button

parent_athlete_minor_access_section.description: parent/athlete/[id].tsx contains 'Accesso Atleta dal Telefono' section (lines 2227-2295) with PIN setup, toggle access, credentials display

critical_code_review_comments: Trial period bypass logic correctly implemented in check_athlete_status function - trial athletes allowed without certificate
PDF generation uses reportlab with proper Italian text formatting
Minor dashboard correctly aggregates trial_info from athlete data
Both frontend sections (Trial Period & Minor Access) properly integrated with backend APIs

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all features verified, minor button click issue with standard login)
